summary: Yum! Brands filed an 8-K confirming completion of its previously announced sale of the global Pizza Hut business, excluding mainland China and the Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan regions, to Toppings TopCo, LLC, an affiliate of LongRange Capital, for $1,488,000,000 in cash, subject to adjustments under the June 16, 2026 Equity Purchase Agreement. Pizza Hut CEO Aaron Powell resigned effective September 1, 2026 in connection with closing. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. Watch post-closing purchase-price adjustments, retained China exposure, and use of proceeds.
